AGRICULTURE — MOCK EXAM #12
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Decomposers only
   C. Producers
   D. Primary consumers only

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. A compound can be separated by filtering only

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Balanced Meal? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Balanced Meal.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Balanced Meal.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Balanced Meal.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Balanced Meal.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Making Tacking Stitches? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Making Tacking Stitches.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Making Tacking Stitches.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Making Tacking Stitches.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Making Tacking Stitches.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Direct Sowing of Tiny Seeds.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Growing Fruits? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Growing Fruits.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Growing Fruits.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Growing Fruits.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Growing Fruits.

8. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. pascal (Pa)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Uses of Domestic Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Uses of Domestic Animals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Uses of Domestic Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Uses of Domestic Animals.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Uses of Domestic Animals.

10. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Iron rusting
   D. Milk souring

11. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Movement of water only across a membrane

12. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 100 °C
   B. 0 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fuel Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Fuel Conservation.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fuel Conservation.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fuel Conservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fuel Conservation.

14. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking Food food frying food? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking Food food frying food.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking Food food frying food.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking Food food frying food.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking Food food frying food.

15. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

16. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

17. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Hygiene.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Hygiene.

18. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

19. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Water Conservation? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Water Conservation.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Water Conservation.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Water Conservation.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Water Conservation.

20. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Personal Protective Equipment.

21. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Domestic Hygiene? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Domestic Hygiene.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Domestic Hygiene.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Domestic Hygiene.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Domestic Hygiene.

22. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Wild Animals? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Wild Animals.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Wild Animals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Wild Animals.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Wild Animals.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
23. In three clear sentences, explain Balanced Meal and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Cooking Food food frying food and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

25. In three clear sentences, explain Personal Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

26. In three clear sentences, explain Domestic Hygiene and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

29. In three clear sentences, explain Water Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

30. In three clear sentences, explain Fuel Conservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
